messages:
Maya: Quick sync — finalizing release notes + internal announcement for the 2026-03-22 rollout. Need final copy + pin decisions. Pinging: @Product-Ops @Chris @Eli
Chris: On it. Draft in this thread in a sec. Confirm change window 02:00–04:00 UTC? That was approved.
Eli: Yup 02:00–04:00 UTC works. We should pin model to rwinf-model-v3-2026-03-20 and keep fallback to v3-quantized.
Sophia: +1 pin. Also add rollback instructions for Dedicated customers and a note about transient 429s during cache warmup.
Chris: Draft below — please edit:
```
Release notes (internal):
- Version: rwinf-model-v3-2026-03-20 (pinned)
- Rollout: staged canary -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over ~4 hours
- Fallback: v3-quantized (automated)
- Change window: 02:00–04:00 UTC
- Known issues: transient 429s during batch warmup; monitoring in place
```
Maya: Nice. Add ops playbook link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/releases/rwinf-v3-playbook
Annika: Support runbook updated. We'll monitor top-5 customer journeys and open an incident channel if error rate > 2%.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy succeeded in us-west-2, latency 95p within SLO, promoted to 25% traffic.
Kevin: Can we schedule the internal announcement for 01:30 UTC with 'heads-up' and copy for engineering, support, sales? I'll draft support blurb.
Product-Ops: Draft for internal announce: 'We are rolling rwinf-model-v3; pinned version rwinf-model-v3-2026-03-20. Expected impact: minimal. See release notes and ops playbook: https://confluence.internal/redwood/releases/rwinf-v3-playbook'
Maya: Perfect. Final checklist: - Pin version (Chris) - Update support runbook (Annika) - Schedule announce (Kevin) - Ops channel (Eli) - Canary -> 25% observed (deploy-bot) - Rollback threshold set at 2% error or 3 consecutive sevs (ops-bot)
Eli: Ops channel is #incidents/releases-196875 — I created it. Will jump in for the window.
Chris: Pin done: `models.pin('rwinf-model', 'rwinf-model-v3-2026-03-20')`
deploy-bot: Rolling to 50% now.
Sophia: I'll send a brief note to enterprise CSMs about the fallback behavior (so they can reassure customers).
Maya: LGTM. If we hit rollback thresholds, use immediate rollback to v3-quantized and page oncall. Everyone ok with announce draft? :eyes:
Annika: LGTM from support.
Kevin: LGTM, scheduling at 01:30 UTC.
Chris: Final copy pushed to the internal template. :shipit:
deploy-bot: Rollout at 50% stable for 12m, proceeding to 100%.
Maya: Thanks team — I'll post the internal announcement at 01:30 UTC and stand by in the ops channel. :white_check_mark:
